input_snapshot.goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

backlogItem.title: Test discovered parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168) on additional BNB data to verify robustness
backlogItem.objective: Test discovered parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168) on additional BNB data to verify robustness

relevant_lessons.lesson: BNB exchange token volatility regime responds to asset-specific parameter tuning
relevant_lessons.specific_finding: Prior run with generic parameters (rsi_oversold=35, rsi_overbought=50, hold_bars=96) yielded 0.432 OOS Sharpe - worst in EMA Trend Gate series. Expanded parameter search (rsi_oversold [25,30,35], rsi_overbought [50-70], hold_bars [96-168]) discovered optimal BNB settings at rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168, achieving 1.275 OOS Sharpe (+195%).

relevant_lessons.lesson: Parameter consistency score of 0.37 indicates adaptive regime behavior, not necessarily overfitting
relevant_lessons.specific_finding: Hold_bars ranges from 96-168 and rsi_overbought 50-70 across windows, yielding consistency score 0.37. However, core parameters (ema1h, ema4h, rsi_period, sl/tp) remain stable at 1.0. Some variation expected in adaptive multi-timeframe regime; the question is whether this level of parameter variation is acceptable for production deployment.

relevant_lessons.lesson: Optimized parameters stable: RSI thresholds (rsi_oversold=35, rsi_overbought=65) have CV=0.10-0.14 across 85 windows. Hold_bars unstable (CV=0.54).
Cross-asset generalization partially confirmed but asset-specific tuning required
relevant_lessons.specific_finding: Same parameters (EMA 50/20, RSI 14, 35/50 thresholds, 96 hold bars) produce widely varying results across assets. SOL and BTC thrive while BNB struggles, indicating exchange tokens need asset-specific parameter adjustment.
